title: 真实HTTPS会话生命周期：登录换SID、旧匿名ID不升权、退出后原始Cookie重放也失效

original_title: 什么是cookie？解释基于cookie的身份验证
body:
## 操作任务
实现rotate/resolve/revoke三个SQLite会话函数，表为sessions(sid主键,user可空,expires)。rotate接收上游已认证用户和可信随机新SID，拒绝空用户/空新SID、新旧相同或新ID碰撞，在事务中删除旧SID并插入新SID/用户/期限，返回新SID；失败不得破坏其他会话。resolve只在该SID存在、user非空且expires>now时返回服务端用户，否则None；客户端user字段不可信。revoke只删除指定SID。真实HTTPS测试从匿名Cookie登录换SID，旧匿名ID不能变为已认证，退出后即便手工重放原始已认证Cookie也应401，真实到期后401。服务端保留Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax标志，客户端CookieJar自动发送与清除；不把清除客户端Cookie当服务端注销。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Python HTTPS服务、仅子客户端信任的临时证书、SQLite持久会话及HTTP CookieJar，测试密码/SID运行时随机生成，仅在自有回环服务中使用。上游密码认证由私有夹具提供，不声称生产身份提供者、浏览器JavaScript/完整SameSite行为、CSRF或多节点会话同步已验证；已有其他题单独覆盖CSRF。未安装宿主CA，不更改正式账号、默认身份或真实登录状态，不构建镜像。
rubric: 核心概念与因果关系准确
前提、限制和验证方式与题意一致

"""Private verified TLS fixtures; ephemeral CA files never enter host trust or default credentials."""
import contextlib,datetime,ipaddress,json,pathlib,ssl,threading,urllib.request,urllib.error
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes,serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa
from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID
def certificate(root):
 root=pathlib.Path(root);root.mkdir(exist_ok=True);now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);key=rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537,key_size=2048)
 name=x509.Name([x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME,'OpsForge ephemeral private TLS fixture')])
 cert=x509.CertificateBuilder().subject_name(name).issuer_name(name).public_key(key.public_key()).serial_number(x509.random_serial_number()).not_valid_before(now-datetime.timedelta(minutes=5)).not_valid_after(now+datetime.timedelta(hours=2)).add_extension(x509.BasicConstraints(ca=True,path_length=None),critical=True).add_extension(x509.SubjectAlternativeName([x509.IPAddress(ipaddress.ip_address('127.0.0.1'))]),critical=False).sign(key,hashes.SHA256())
 pem=root/'ca.pem';private=root/'key.pem';pem.write_bytes(cert.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM));private.write_bytes(key.private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM,serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,serialization.NoEncryption()))
 context=ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER);context.load_cert_chain(str(pem),str(private));return pem,context
@contextlib.contextmanager
def server(root,handler):
 pem,context=certificate(root);http=ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),handler);http.daemon_threads=True;http.socket=context.wrap_socket(http.socket,server_side=True)
 thread=threading.Thread(target=http.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
 try:yield 'https://127.0.0.1:'+str(http.server_port),pem
 finally:http.shutdown();http.server_close();thread.join(timeout=3)
def client(cafile,jar=None):
 context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(cafile));handlers=[urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}),urllib.request.HTTPSHandler(context=context)]
 if jar is not None:handlers.append(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))
 opener=urllib.request.build_opener(*handlers)
 def call(method,url,payload=None,headers=None):
  req=urllib.request.Request(url,data=json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else (b'' if method=='POST' else None),method=method,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json',**(headers or {})})
  try:
   with opener.open(req,timeout=4) as r:status,raw,response_headers=r.status,r.read().decode(),dict(r.headers)
  except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:status,raw,response_headers=e.code,e.read().decode(),dict(e.headers)
  try:body=json.loads(raw)
  except ValueError:body=raw
  return status,body,response_headers
 return call

import contextlib,http.cookiejar,json,pathlib,secrets,sqlite3,sys,tempfile,time
from http.cookies import SimpleCookie
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks"))
import task
from private_tls_http import server,client
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-cookie-session-") as temp:
 root=pathlib.Path(temp);db=root/"sessions.sqlite";old=secrets.token_urlsafe(32);issued=secrets.token_urlsafe(32);password=secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
 with contextlib.closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c,c:
  c.execute("CREATE TABLE sessions(sid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user TEXT,expires REAL)")
  c.execute("INSERT INTO sessions VALUES(?,?,?)",(old,None,time.time()+60))
 class App(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
  def log_message(self,*args):pass
  def sid(self):
   cookie=SimpleCookie();cookie.load(self.headers.get("Cookie",""));return cookie["sid"].value if "sid" in cookie else ""
  def respond(self,status,body,header=None):
   raw=json.dumps(body).encode();self.send_response(status)
   if header:self.send_header("Set-Cookie",header)
   self.send_header("Content-Type","application/json");self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(raw)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(raw)
  def do_GET(self):
   with contextlib.closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c,c:user=task.resolve(c,self.sid(),time.time())
   self.respond(200 if user else 401,{"user":user})
  def do_POST(self):
   payload=json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("Content-Length","0"))) or b"{}")
   with contextlib.closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c,c:
    if self.path=="/login":
     if payload.get("password")!=password:return self.respond(401,{"error":"fixture authentication rejected"})
     sid=task.rotate(c,self.sid(),"fixture-user",issued,time.time()+60)
     return self.respond(200,{"ok":True},"sid="+sid+"; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax")
    if self.path=="/logout":
     task.revoke(c,self.sid());return self.respond(200,{"ok":True},"sid=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax")
    self.respond(404,{})
 with server(root/"tls",App) as (base,ca):
  raw=client(ca);jar=http.cookiejar.CookieJar();browserlike=client(ca,jar)
  assert raw("GET",base+"/me",headers={"Cookie":"sid="+old})[0]==401
  print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: actual TLS login rotates anonymous session and server-side logout revokes it",flush=True)
  status,body,headers=browserlike("POST",base+"/login",{"password":password},headers={"Cookie":"sid="+old});assert status==200
  assert raw("GET",base+"/me",headers={"Cookie":"sid="+old})[0]==401,"pre-login session must not become authenticated"
  assert browserlike("GET",base+"/me")[:2]==(200,{"user":"fixture-user"})
  assert len(list(jar))==1 and list(jar)[0].value==issued and list(jar)[0].secure
  cookie=SimpleCookie();cookie.load(headers["Set-Cookie"]);assert cookie["sid"]["httponly"] and cookie["sid"]["samesite"]=="Lax"
  assert raw("GET",base+"/me",headers={"Cookie":"sid=forged; user=admin"})[0]==401
  print("NATIVE_TLS_COOKIE_LOGIN_FRESH_ID_OLD_ANONYMOUS_ID_REJECTED_SERVER_SESSION_LOOKUP_AND_COOKIE_FLAGS",flush=True)
  assert browserlike("POST",base+"/logout",{})[0]==200
  assert not list(jar)
  assert raw("GET",base+"/me",headers={"Cookie":"sid="+issued})[0]==401,"clearing client cookie does not revoke server state by itself"
  expiring=secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
  with contextlib.closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c,c:c.execute("INSERT INTO sessions VALUES(?,?,?)",(expiring,"fixture-user",time.time()+.15))
  time.sleep(.2);assert raw("GET",base+"/me",headers={"Cookie":"sid="+expiring})[0]==401
  with contextlib.closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c,c:
   survivor=secrets.token_urlsafe(32);c.execute("INSERT INTO sessions VALUES(?,?,?)",(survivor,"other-session",time.time()+60));c.commit()
   try:task.rotate(c,survivor,"fixture-user",survivor,time.time()+60)
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError("session ID reuse accepted")
   assert task.resolve(c,survivor,time.time())=="other-session"
  print("NATIVE_TLS_COOKIE_LOGOUT_RAW_REPLAY_REJECTED_REAL_EXPIRY_REJECTED_OTHER_SESSION_PRESERVED",flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
